summary.zh: 鼠标放上去或键盘聚焦时，一道亮光从按钮左边扫到右边
summary.en: On hover or keyboard focus, a band of light sweeps across the button

ref: Magic UI · Shimmer Button（独立实现）

reduced.zh: 不扫光，悬停时按钮变亮一点
reduced.en: No sweep; the button brightens on hover

dont_use.zh: 同一屏多个按钮同时用；次要按钮；密集工具栏。只给主按钮。
dont_use.en: Several buttons in one view, secondary buttons, dense toolbars. Primary button only.
